title: Widget
description: Abstract base of the 10 template widget types.

id.description: Combined anonymous instance identifier: the widget's type chain followed by a UUID. The rightmost type of the chain is the widget type. The widget has no other identifier and no name of its own.

title.description: Display title shown in the widget chrome, as delivered.

description.description: A short line under the title. Without it the header shows the title alone.

render.description: Presentation fields, closed by each concrete widget type through its own render type or inline.

entry.description: The MFE entry the widget type renders through.

render_type.description: The render type of the widget type. Without it the root stamps render with the base render type.
